name: regex
title: Match with an ICU regular expression

origin.description: regex() is the default stringr pattern. It uses ICU regular expressions and records the flags that were requested.
origin.usage: regex(pattern, ignore_case = FALSE, multiline = FALSE, comments = FALSE, dotall = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Regular expression. A value that is not a plain character vector is coerced, with a warning.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: If TRUE, letters match without regard to case.

arguments.name: multiline
arguments.text: If TRUE, ^ and $ match the start and end of each line. If FALSE, they match the whole input.

arguments.name: comments
arguments.text: If TRUE, white space and comments that begin with # are ignored. A literal space is escaped with a backslash and a space.

arguments.name: dotall
arguments.text: If TRUE, . also matches a line terminator.

origin.details: case_insensitive, comments, dotall, and multiline are always stored. The formal dotall and multiline are passed through, so the aliases dot_all and multi_line do not override them. Other settings, such as time_limit, are inserted where stri_opts_regex places them.
origin.value: The pattern, with classes stringr_regex, stringr_pattern, and character, and a regex option list.

translation.description: regex() builds an ICU regular expression and stores the four flags on the pattern.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Regular expression. A string or a list of strings is kept. Other objects are coerced with a warning.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: If True, letters match without regard to case.

arguments.name: multiline
arguments.text: If True, ^ and $ match each line. If False, they match the whole string.

arguments.name: comments
arguments.text: If True, white space and # comments are ignored.

arguments.name: dotall
arguments.text: If True, . also matches a line terminator.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to stri_opts_regex. The formal dotall and multiline win over dot_all and multi_line.

translation.details: The option dict always contains case_insensitive, comments, dotall, and multiline, in that order, with any extra limits placed where stri_opts_regex places them. Each flag must be True or False.
translation.value: A Pattern of kind regex. The text is the pattern, and the four flags are in options.
translation.example:
from stringr.pattern import regex
regex("[a-z]+", ignore_case=True)
